description: A lens: one way of seeing the library, written as data (docs/LENSES.md, "The lens kit"). flux removes from it anything that could run or load (scripts, links, images, `url()`, inline styles) and runs `layout` in a locked-down worker.

animated.description: Ask for a frame every tick (only if `layout` moves things by itself with `view.t`).

blurb.description: One plain sentence: what it looks like and how you move through it (at most 160).

css.description: The look. Every selector starts with `.lens` (at most 14,000 characters).

input.description: Which scroll axis moves through the titles.

item.description:
HTML for one title, with `{{title}}`, `{{year}}`, … and `
` where the poster goes (at most 4,000).

name.description: One or two words (at most 28 characters).

scene.description: Static HTML behind the titles, decoration only (at most 4,000).

step.description: Pixels of scroll or drag per title (30–600).

window.description: Titles drawn either side of the position (8–150).

title: LensSpec
